vocab.example: We met three new partners at the trade show in Singapore.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đã gặp ba đối tác mới tại hội chợ thương mại ở Singapore.

vocab.example: Our stand had more than two hundred visitors on the first day.
vocab.example_vi: Gian hàng của chúng tôi có hơn hai trăm khách tham quan trong ngày đầu.

vocab.example: Let us connect on LinkedIn after the event.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy kết nối trên LinkedIn sau sự kiện nhé.

vocab.example: Smile and approach visitors who stop to look at the screen.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy mỉm cười và bắt chuyện với khách dừng lại xem màn hình.

vocab.example: We exchanged contact details and agreed to talk next week.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đã trao đổi thông tin liên lạc và hẹn nói chuyện tuần sau.

vocab.example: We give a free sample to every visitor who fills in the form.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi tặng hàng mẫu miễn phí cho mỗi khách điền phiếu.

vocab.example: Our stand is near the entrance, so the foot traffic is high.
vocab.example_vi: Gian hàng của chúng ta gần lối vào nên lượng khách đi qua rất đông.

vocab.example: Please add everyone we met today to the contact list.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng thêm tất cả những người ta gặp hôm nay vào danh sách liên hệ.

listening.title: Meeting a buyer at a trade show

lines.speaker: Vy (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Hello! Welcome to our stand. Are you enjoying the trade show?

lines.speaker: Đức (Buyer)
lines.text: Yes, it is busy but interesting. What does your company do?

lines.speaker: Vy (Sales Executive)
lines.text: We make smart packaging for food companies. It keeps products fresh longer.

lines.speaker: Đức (Buyer)
lines.text: That sounds useful. I work for a coffee brand in Đà Nẵng.

lines.speaker: Vy (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Great! Many coffee brands use our bags. Would you like a free sample?

lines.speaker: Đức (Buyer)
lines.text: Sure, thank you. I can show it to my purchasing team.

lines.speaker: Vy (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Perfect. Could we exchange business details? I would like to send you our price list.

lines.speaker: Đức (Buyer)
lines.text: Of course. Here is my card. You can also connect with me on LinkedIn.

lines.speaker: Vy (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Thank you. I will email you on Monday, after the event.

lines.speaker: Đức (Buyer)
lines.text: Sounds good. Nice to meet you, Vy.

shadowing: Hi, thanks for stopping by our stand, can I tell you about our product?
What brings you to the trade show this year, are you looking for suppliers?
Here is my card, it has my email and phone number on it.
It was great talking to you, I will send you more details next week.
Would you like to try a free sample before you leave the stand?
